policy: Use explicit completed depths below ground where supplied. If missing, subtract the nondeprecated inner-stickup height (AB) from final depth below stickup (R), with the calculation labeled. Do not infer depths from original drilled depths or deprecated approximate stickup values (V). Retain disagreement without silently reconciling.

qualifications: Bare NC01 and NC03 GIS points are not the suffixed G/NP installations; no alias or depth is assigned.
NC01-G, NC02, NC03-NP, NC04 and NC06-NP have final depths referenced to stickup but no nondeprecated inner-stickup height; these remain unavailable as completed ground depths.
SR21 has 7.93 m from stickup and 8.92 m originally drilled; no nondeprecated stickup height is supplied, so neither is silently used as a completed ground depth.
Port metadata contains sand-pack intervals, not geologic layers. Some recorded intervals extend beyond separately recorded completed depths; do not clip or silently move them.

The simpler archive-root Well Metadata sheet mixes depths and hole aliases: e.g. NC05 9.98 equals NC05-G final stickup depth, while NC05-NP has a different completed depth. It is not used as authority for completed ground depths.
